title: Elijah Flees to Horeb

questions.question: Who threatened to kill Elijah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:2 (ESV): "Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, 'So may the gods do to me and more also, if I do not make your life as the life of one of them by this time tomorrow.'"

questions.question: Where did Elijah flee to first?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:3 (ESV): "Then he was afraid, and he arose and ran for his life and came to Beersheba..."

questions.question: How did God speak to Elijah at Horeb?
options: In a low whisper (still small voice)
questions.correctAnswer: In a low whisper (still small voice)
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:12 (ESV): "...and after the fire the sound of a low whisper."

questions.question: Who was Elijah told to anoint as prophet in his place?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:16 (ESV): "...and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah you shall anoint to be prophet in your place."

questions.question: What was Elisha doing when Elijah found him?
options: Plowing with twelve yoke of oxen
questions.correctAnswer: Plowing with twelve yoke of oxen
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:19 (ESV): "So he departed from there and found Elisha... who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen..."

questions.question: How long did Elijah travel to get to Horeb?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:8 (ESV): "...and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, the mount of God."

questions.question: What question did God ask Elijah in the cave?
options: What are you doing here, Elijah?
questions.correctAnswer: What are you doing here, Elijah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:9 (ESV): "...And behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said to him, 'What are you doing here, Elijah?'"

questions.question: Who was Elijah told to anoint as king over Syria?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:15 (ESV): "...Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. And when you arrive, you shall anoint Hazael to be king over Syria."

questions.question: Who was Elijah told to anoint as king over Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:16 (ESV): "And Jehu the son of Nimshi you shall anoint to be king over Israel..."

questions.question: How many people in Israel had not bowed the knee to Baal?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:18 (ESV): "Yet I will leave seven thousand in Israel, all the knees that have not bowed to Baal..."

questions.question: What tree did Elijah sit under when he asked to die?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:4 (ESV): "...and he came and sat down under a broom tree. And he asked that he might die..."

questions.question: Who provided food for Elijah in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:5 (ESV): "And behold, an angel touched him and said to him, 'Arise and eat.'"

questions.question: What did the angel provide specifically?
options: A cake baked on hot stones and a jar of water
questions.correctAnswer: A cake baked on hot stones and a jar of water
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:6 (ESV): "And he looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on hot stones and a jar of water."

questions.question: What did Elisha do with his oxen?
options: Sacrificed them and boiled their flesh with the yokes
questions.correctAnswer: Sacrificed them and boiled their flesh with the yokes
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:21 (ESV): "...And he took the yoke of oxen and sacrificed them and boiled their flesh with the yokes of the oxen..."

questions.question: What was the first natural phenomenon God was NOT in?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:11 (ESV): "...but the LORD was not in the wind..."

key_verse_text: And after the earthquake a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire the sound of a low whisper. (ESV)
